pages: Greetings from your Columbus District Field Technical Consultants Technical Tools to help better serve you! Do you need technical assistance from Lennox that goes above and beyond just a phone call? Are you aware that your Field Technical Consultant as well as the Inside Tech Support Group have tools to do just that? We have available to us a tool called “Tech Video”. When there is a need to visually see what the technician on site is seeing we can send a link through text to link their device and view the equipment in real time. This tool also provides other features such as Picture Capturing, Recording Capability, Pointing & Notation Features for the technician, and other capabilities. It is very easy to use. All the tech has to do is click on the link and agree to a couple items and share their camera. The advantage of this is to visually see the equipment operation in real time to diagnose operational and equipment issues accurately and timely. When an in-person job site visit is requested, it must be scheduled and can be up to several weeks out. Tech Video can be utilized to help resolve the technical issues and/or Homeowner concerns in a timelier manner. We realize that an in-person visit is warranted in some cases, but with scheduling demands we must use the tools that are available to us when possible. In most cases Dallas Tech Support should be the first line of contact for Technical & Application help. The contact information is below. All calls to Tech Support for Residential or Commercial will go through 1-800-453-6669 and follow the prompts to the appropriate department. Residential Tech Service prompts are, 2-1-2 Residential Tech Application prompts are, 2-1-3 Commercial Tech Support prompts are, 2-2-2 Commercial Tech Application prompts are, 2-2-3 Commercial Tech Support Controls prompts are, 2-2-4 We are here to help you resolve any technical or application issue. For us to help you in the most timely and accurate way please have all job, operation data and equipment information prior to the call. We have attached a few data collection forms to aid the technician in data collection prior to calling us. This will reduce the time to resolve the issues. Help us help you! Thank you for your help and understanding.
